top_signals.title: Molten Salt Reactors Just Cleared A Major U.S. Regulatory Hurdle
top_signals.summary: domestic nuclear energy sector is set to bounce back as the technology finds favor among the public and policymakers alike for its ability to provide round-the-clock clean energy. At a time when data center hyperscalers are driving up energy insecurity and climate deadlines are drawing ever closer, the nuclear option is looking better and better.
